_about: Score-note guards shared by scripts/apply-briefing-staging.py and scripts/check-data.mjs. protectedPrefixes: text a score note must keep at its start, which the scraper does not re-report. bannedFragments: note segments the scraper must never write, for one row (modelId) or a whole board (no modelId).

protectedPrefixes.why: AA lists this as the reasoning, default max effort row; the AA index scrape only reports 'best listed row'.

bannedFragments.why: Removed on 20 and 21 Oct as unverified. Other Harvey rows keep their ungated figure; lift this entry if Colton OKs it (AA page data has ungatedAverageAllPass 0.2083 next to Argon 3.82 hallucinations per task).
